about.title: About ContentForge
about.intro: ContentForge is an AI multi-platform content repurposing tool for Chinese creators.
about.intro2: We believe creators should spend their time on thinking and writing the master piece, not mechanically reformatting the same article five times.
about.origin: The project was born from OpenAI's 2026 "Harness Engineering" practice — built entirely by AI agents in a structured environment, with humans handling direction, acceptance, and business logic.
about.missionDesc: Empower individual creators to run their content business with micro-SaaS efficiency: one deep article, forged into distribution-ready assets for every platform.
about.businessDesc: Free tier for cold-start users; Pro (¥29/mo) for daily creators; Team plan for MCNs and brand operations. Future plans include payments, collaboration, and OpenAI API enhancement.

footer.desc: Write once, publish everywhere. Save 80% of distribution time for creators and content marketers.
